function: Deep prior network refines the ISAC dual-functional precoder to maximize sensing power while minimizing eavesdropper SINR under pilot spoofing, without eavesdropper or victim CSI (p. 1-3).
system: MISO ISAC downlink: BS with 5 transmit and 5 radar-receive antennas, 5 single-antenna users, 3 targets, 1 eavesdropper; no RIS; frequency band not stated (p. 2, p. 4).
method: 3-layer MLP deep prior (512-1024 neurons) plugged into ADMM precoder iterations; deep-unfolding style, unsupervised training with layer-wise loss and progressive iterations (p. 3-4).
data_channel: Own simulator, no dataset: Rician channels (kappa = 1), LoS plus scattered part; channels, Eve DOA and BS power random in training (p. 2, p. 4).
test_conditions: Trained on random channels, Eve DOA and BS power at fixed attack strength; tested over BS power 20-60 dBm and kappa 0.5-1, retraining not stated (p. 4-5).
baselines: Non-learned only: method of [12] ignoring PSA (S1) and under PSA (S2); no earlier learned method compared (p. 4).
metrics: Bob and Eve communication SINR, user constraint violation rate, sensing SINR versus BS power, SINR versus iterations (p. 4-5).
complexity: Total O(I_DM K Nt^2.373), dominated by the optimization step; NN inference O(1024 x 2K Nt); computation time up less than 5% versus original (p. 4).
q1_support: p. 2: "Rician-κ fading channels with additive white Gaussian noise (AWGN)"; custom simulator set up as in [12], no standardized model or measured data named.
q2_support: p. 4: "During training, channels, Eve's DOA, and BS power are randomly generated." The BS power sweep lies in this training range; Fig. 5 (p. 5) varies kappa 0.5-1, but the paper never states the training kappa or that the model was tested without retraining.
q3_support: p. 4: "(S1) Precoding without considering PSA using the method in [12]; (S2) Precoding under PSA using the method in [12]"; only the non-learned optimization of [12], no earlier learned method compared.
q4_support: p. 4: "the total complexity is O(IDM KNt2.373)"; also "increases computation time by less than 5% compared to original methods".
q5_support: p. 4: "During training, channels, Eve's DOA, and BS power are randomly generated." Data come from the authors' own simulator; no code or data link or DOI, and no public dataset.
notes: Area 5: pilot spoofing defense is posed as ISAC precoder design under sensing and user SINR constraints (p. 2); the trained deep prior inside the ADMM loop is a learned component (deep unfolding), so no_learning and function checks pass. Fig. 5 sweeps kappa 0.5-1 while the text sets kappa = 1 (p. 4); retraining per kappa is not stated, so q2 is 0 and the reviewer may confirm.
